heads.en: In the event that the election will bring together Korean Yoga Zhuangan gold: a cloud-demonstrating army of thousands of horses to meet for 17 days in the final countdown, Taipei Mayor Zhuan Anhung (11) will attend the opening of the Water New World and Public Stadium in the morning, ending the last municipal event during his term. In the face of the press's concern that official leave will be put to the election by the beginning of next year, Zhuanan's visit confirmed that the law would allow him to take leave, and that he would then communicate with the public in all corners of Taipei; he also stressed that the city's team would remain on guard and that the city's advancement would not be compromised. 12 minutes ago, the election took place in Korean Yoga, and the following sentence was quoted: "One with clouds and arrows, one with thousands of horses and thousands of horses."

heads.t: 移民署要陸客手寫「台獨聲明」才准來台 藍委怒：像獨裁國家做法 近日一名陸客申請來台觀光，但因飯店訂房單出現「中國台灣」字樣，被要求重新提供去除「矮化」文字的訂房單，同時須手寫「尊重台灣為主權獨立之國家、兩岸互不隸屬」等文字，事件曝光引發議論。對此，國民黨團書記長許宇甄今（11）日直言，台灣是民主國家，這種做法比較像「獨裁國家」，難道其他國家觀光客出現類似情況，也不准入境嗎？ 26 分鐘前｜政治 移民署要陸客手寫「台獨聲明」才准來台 藍委怒：像獨裁國家做法 26 分鐘前｜政治

秦慧珠同框沈伯洋遭藍基層出征！賴清德聲援：絕非民主應有價值 國民黨台北市議員秦慧珠近日因同框民進黨台北市長候選人沈伯洋、兩人還開心合照比「3號」手勢，還去造訪「洋流」店家又一村水餃店，讓藍營基層不滿出征。總統賴清德今（11）日表示，近期卻看到有些店家或個人，僅僅因為表態支持特定候選人，或是媒體採訪特定候選人，就遭受不當侵擾，甚至受到出征，讓當事人承受相當大的壓力，相互攻擊、製造對立，甚至造成社會撕裂，絕非民主選舉應有的精神與價值。 27 分鐘前｜政治 秦慧珠同框沈伯洋遭藍基層出征！賴清德聲援：絕非民主應有價值 27 分鐘前｜政治

As a result of his recent visit to Taipei City councillor Shen Boyang, a candidate for president-elect of Taipei, the two were happy to take a picture of the 3rd and visit another village's waterfront shop, which made the Blue Bases dissatisfied. President Laixing Deutsche today (11) said that he had recently seen shopkeepers or individuals who had been inappropriately harassed or even called out because they had expressed support for a particular candidate, or because the media had visited a particular candidate, putting considerable pressure on the party, attacking each other, creating confrontations, and even tearing societies apart, and denying the spirit and value of undemocratic elections. 27 minutes ago Qin Hye Ju and Shen Boyang were attacked by the Blue Base! heads.t: 挺卓榮泰不副署老人免健保 賴清德：不讓年輕世代不合理承擔 藍白黨團聯手在立法院三讀通過《老人福利法》修正案，讓65歲以上、所得稅級距未達20%的長者免繳健保費，由中央全額補助，而行政院長卓榮泰決定不予副署反制，引發在野不滿。總統兼民進黨主席賴清德今（11）日力挺卓榮泰，表示要讓年輕世代不必承擔不合理的財政負擔，更不該讓攸關全民福祉的社會福利議題，淪為政黨間政治攻防的工具。 28 分鐘前｜政治 挺卓榮泰不副署老人免健保 賴清德：不讓年輕世代不合理承擔 28 分鐘前｜政治
heads.en: The Blue and White Party joined forces in the Legislative Assembly to read and pass the amendment to the Old People's Welfare Act, which exempts older people over 65 years of age and less than 20 per cent of the tax scale, from health insurance, and is fully funded by the central government, while the director of the administration, Cheon Rong-tae, decided not to back down and caused dissatisfaction in the field. The President and President of the National Progressive Party (PNP), Li Qing Dynasty (11th) has been very active, saying that it is not for the younger generation to bear unreasonable financial burdens, much less for social welfare issues related to the well-being of the entire population to become a tool for inter-party political defense. 28 minutes ago, politics was pretty much off-limits for senior citizens.

heads.t: 黃仁勳4.96兆元「離婚1條件均分給妻」 律師：加州外遇不能求償 輝達執行長黃仁勳近日公開坦承婚外情，外界對於其婚姻狀況及財產分配產生高度關注。律師劉韋廷指出，黃仁勳身家約新台幣4.96兆元，若與妻子Lori Huang離婚，依照美國加州夫妻共同財產制度，僅婚姻期間累積的共同淨財產可平均分配，並非直接對半。另外加州法律與台灣不同，外遇並不能據此要求精神賠償，僅能針對不當移轉的共同財產主張權利。 21 分鐘前｜社會 黃仁勳4.96兆元「離婚1條件均分給妻」 律師：加州外遇不能求償 21 分鐘前｜社會
heads.en: The lawyer for Huang In-hoon's 4.96 trillion dollar "one condition for divorce": California's affair cannot be paid for. Counsel Liu Wetin points out that if he divorces his wife, Lori Huaang, he can only divide the amount of the common and clean property accumulated during the marriage evenly and not directly in half. In addition, unlike Taiwan, California’s laws do not require moral compensation in the event of an affair, except for claims against a common property owner who has been improperly transferred. Twenty-one minutes ago, Huang In-hoon gave his wife a divorce.

heads.t: 北韓最新憲法大談「兩國論」！刪除統一條文 徹底切割南韓 北韓對外宣傳媒體時隔兩年八個月，於今（11）日重新公開修訂後的憲法全文。新憲法正式寫入最高領導人金正恩提出的「敵對兩國論」，首度在領土條文中明確點名「大韓民國」，徹底切斷與南韓的同胞關係並刪除祖國統一相關條文，同時進一步強化金正恩對國家核武體系的合法指揮權。 2 分鐘前｜國際 北韓最新憲法大談「兩國論」！刪除統一條文 徹底切割南韓 2 分鐘前｜國際
